title: Security & Privacy GUI v1 recovery
description: Restore missing GUI scheduled task, apply native Threats/Blocklist/Allowlist patch, start 8765 and verify 8766 bridge.
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root='C:/3EN-Agent';$work=Join-Path $root 'security-privacy-stack';$ui=Join-Path $work '3en-security-privacy-web.py';$patch=Join-Path $root 'patch-security-privacy-gui-v1.py';Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri ('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/3en4all/3en-command-runner/main/scripts/patch-security-privacy-gui-v1.py?ts='+[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()) -OutFile $patch -TimeoutSec 30;$py=(Get-Command python.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source;if(-not $py){$py=(Get-Command py.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source};& $py $patch;if($LASTEXITCODE-ne0){throw 'GUI_V1_PATCH_FAILED'};$task='3EN Security Privacy UI';$act=New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute $py -Argument ('"'+$ui+'"');$tr=New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -AtLogOn;$pr=New-ScheduledTaskPrincipal -UserId $env:USERNAME -LogonType Interactive -RunLevel Limited;Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName $task -Action $act -Trigger $tr -Principal $pr -Force|Out-Null;Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Where-Object{$_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine -like '*3en-security-privacy-web.py*'}|ForEach-Object{Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue};Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName $task;Start-Sleep -Seconds 4;Write-Host 'GUI_V1_RECOVERY_START=PASS'
test: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$h=Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8765/' -TimeoutSec 15;foreach($needle in @('data-tab="threats"','data-tab="blocklist"','data-tab="allowlist"','Block selected','sortThreats')){if($h.Content -notmatch [regex]::Escape($needle)){throw ('GUI_MISSING='+$needle)}};$t=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8765/api/threats' -TimeoutSec 15;if($null-eq $t.items){throw 'THREAT_API_ITEMS_MISSING'};$b=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8766/api/status' -TimeoutSec 15;if(-not $b.routerSsh){throw 'BRIDGE_ROUTER_SSH_UNHEALTHY'};$st=Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName '3EN Security Privacy UI' -ErrorAction Stop;Write-Host ('GUI_V1_RECOVERY_ACCEPTANCE=PASS;TASK='+$st.State+';THREATS='+@($t.items).Count+';ALLOW='+@($t.lists.allow).Count+';BLOCK='+@($t.lists.block).Count)
